# Content

**Personality:** reliable, calm, confident, trustworthy, warm, approachable. Write for security professionals and enterprise buyers: precise and jargon-aware, never intimidating or overly technical in marketing copy.

### Address the reader

![Do: The Qualys Cloud Platform gives your team a single source of truth across your environment. Do not: We give users a single source of truth across their environment.](data:image/webp;base64,)

Second person — "you", "your team", "your environment". Use "we" sparingly, for company context only, never in product descriptions.

### Casing

![Three cases: Title Case for the heading Detect, Prioritize, and Eliminate Risk; sentence case for body copy; all caps only for a NEW tag and a CLOUD PLATFORM eyebrow.](data:image/webp;base64,)

Title Case for headings, display text, buttons, tab names and CTAs — never all caps for headings. Sentence case for body copy, UI text, descriptions and labels under stats. All caps only for short labels: tags and eyebrows.

### Length

![A five-word heading marked under ten words, above one sentence of supporting copy marked one to three sentences.](data:image/webp;base64,)

Headings under ten words. Supporting copy one to three sentences. No padding.

### CTAs

![Buttons and text links that start with a verb: Get a Demo, Get Started, Register Now, Learn More, Explore the Platform, Download Report. Passive labels such as More Information and Demo Request are marked wrong.](data:image/webp;base64,)

**CTAs** start with an action verb and are never passive: "Get a Demo", "Get Started", "Learn More", "Register Now", "Explore the Platform", "Download Report".

### Numbers

![Running copy spells the number out, Set up in three steps; a stat uses numerals, 3,847 patched.](data:image/webp;base64,)

Spell out one to nine in running copy; numerals for stats, data and UI labels ("3,847 patched").

### Punctuation

![The Oxford comma highlighted in Detect, Prioritize, and Eliminate Risk; an em dash highlighted in One platform, every asset; the same line with a hyphen is marked wrong.](data:image/webp;base64,)

Oxford comma. Em dashes for emphasis — not hyphens.

### Dates and times

![Five date formats: long date Mon Dec 9, 2024; short date Dec 9, 2024; date and time Mon Dec 9, 2024 10:00 to 11:00a PST; time range 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM; event card Dec 10, 2026, bullet, 11a PST.](data:image/webp;base64,)

**Dates and times** (Figma Typography page): long date "Mon Dec 9, 2024" for headers, detail pages and featured content; short date "Dec 9, 2024" on compact cards; date and time range "Mon Dec 9, 2024  10:00 – 11:00a PST" for events; time range alone "8:00 AM – 12:00 PM" when the date is already clear. Event cards join the short date and start time with a bullet: "Dec 10, 2026 • 11a PST". Set dates and times in Medium (500).

### No emoji

**No emoji** in product or marketing copy.

Examples in the house voice:

> **Detect, Prioritize, and Eliminate Risk**
> The Qualys Cloud Platform gives your team a single source of truth across your entire hybrid IT environment.
> [Get a Demo] [Explore the Platform]
